title: Interior estimates for Hessian quotient equations
summary: We prove interior Hessian estimates in arbitrary dimensions for admissible solutions of Hessian quotient equations with constant right-hand side, when the numerator and denominator differ in degree by one or two. Counterexamples show that this degree range is optimal. The proof combines a new nonlinear comparison function, a doubling maximum principle, and a Pogorelov estimate.
